business.description: Igarashi Motors India Limited (IMIL) is a leading global player in actuator motors for automotive components, offering tech-neutral solutions from actuator motors powering critical automotive systems to energy-efficient BLDC solutions. The company has evolved from a contract manufacturer into a major player in design and manufacture of critical automotive applications and entered energy-efficient BLDC motors for ceiling fans in 2020.

outlook.statement: The Company remains well positioned to capitalize on improving market conditions and deliver sustainable long-term growth, with internal fundamentals remaining robust and order pipeline healthy.

Focus on strengthening leadership across key product portfolios, expanding presence in next-generation motor technologies, enhancing manufacturing efficiency through automation and operational excellence, deepening OEM partnerships, broadening product offerings and pursuing sustainable growth opportunities across businesses.
Global trade realignment and multi-sourcing approach by OEMs/Tier-1 suppliers positions India as credible manufacturing hub; Company to benefit from strategic shift in global supply chain dynamics.

BEE 2.0 norms implementation accelerating transition to BLDC-based solutions; Company positioned to capture emerging opportunities in energy-efficient applications with advanced BLDC driver platforms, improved controllers, and smart features.

Global automotive industry projected to reach USD 8,508.56 billion by 2035 (CAGR 6.92%); Indian 4W actuator market expected to grow at CAGR 6.72% to USD 3.62 billion by 2026; India Automotive Actuators Market projected CAGR over 7.8% between 2025-2030
Indian economy real GDP growth expected 6.8%-7.2% in FY 2026-27; global GDP growth projected 3.1% in 2026, 3.2% in 2027
Molded Stator program for Europe & North America set to launch in H1 FY2026-27 with expected volumes of 4-5 million units over 3-5 years
Two molded armature assembly programs for domestic Tier-1 customer with SOP in H1 FY2026-27, anticipated volumes over 3 million units in next 3-5 years
Two additional seat motor sub-assembly programs in pipeline with expected volumes over 5-6 million units across next 3-5 years
BLDC stator assemblies for CCH pump program with European Tier-1 (SOP commenced FY2025-26); battery cooling system for EV under validation; expected volumes ~3-5 million units in forward years
BLDC stator and rotor assemblies for damper actuator with South-East Asian customer, targeted launch timeline 12-15 months, projected volumes 2-3 million units in forward years
10 BLDC ceiling fan programs with 6 major customers, expected cumulative volumes ~7-8 million units over next 3-5 years
Actuator motor for stabilizer bar with Korean Tier-1 supplier, expecting launch in coming years with cumulative volume nearly 3 million motors
Actuator motor for air lumbar support (1, 7, 13 channel) with Korean Tier-1 supplier, expected launch FY2027-28 with cumulative volume 2-3 million motors
Overall Indian fan market projected to reach ~72 million units by 2029, driven by premiumization trends including IoT-enabled features
Global active stabilizer bar actuator market ~USD 2.1B in 2025, expected to reach ~USD 4.0B by 2034 (~4.4% CAGR)
Global air lumbar support market ~USD 2.1B in 2025, expected to grow ~USD 3.7B by 2034 (~5.4% CAGR)
IMIL has adopted a strategic roadmap to increase its renewable energy usage from the current, further enhancing its sustainability footprint by upgrading the energy efficient system.
The R&D team working on design innovation for overall reduction in energy consumption and packaging material of our products.
